zh.title: 離島部分航班訂位近滿 民航局籲選舉返鄉民眾善用海運
zh.summary: 民航局表示部分離島航班訂位近滿，建議選舉返鄉民眾善用海運。
body: 交通部民用航空局表示，因應地方公職人員選舉期間離島民眾返鄉投票需求，已協調航空公司規劃航班及加開班機。目前離島航線訂位需求踴躍，部分日期及時段航班已接近滿訂。
民航局指出，11月27日至30日選舉疏運期間，國內航線共提供1,010架次、73,864個座位，其中澎湖、金門及馬祖航線合計提供68,590個座位。
民航局提醒有返鄉需求的民眾，也可利用海運船班，彈性安排往返行程。民航局將持續掌握各航線訂位情形，並視旅運需求協調航空公司適時調整運能。

en.title: Taiwan CAA says some island flights are nearly fully booked amid election travel, suggests ferries
en.summary: Taiwan’s CAA says some island flights are nearly fully booked amid election travel, suggesting ferries.
body: Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) said it has coordinated with airlines to plan flights and add services for outlying-island residents returning home to vote in local elections. It said booking demand on island routes is strong, with flights on some dates and at some times nearly fully booked.

The agency said domestic routes are scheduled to provide 1,010 flights and 73,864 seats during the November 27–30 election travel period. Routes serving Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu account for 68,590 of those seats.

The CAA advised people returning home to consider sea services and arrange their journeys flexibly. It said it would continue monitoring route bookings and coordinate with airlines to adjust capacity as travel demand requires.
